title: From sealed packs to priced cards
target: A routine for handling sealed product: what to keep sealed, what to open, and how opened cards reach a shelf priced.
version: no version stated by this build (see the sources page)
prerequisites: An automatic opener if you have unlocked one

steps.do: Keep some sealed product where customers can buy it and open the rest yourself.
steps.because: packaging boxes come in separate kinds for cards, items and shelves (InteractablePackagingBox_Card, InteractablePackagingBox_Item, InteractablePackagingBox_Shelf)

steps.do: Use the automatic opener when you are opening in bulk.
steps.because: an automatic opener exists and keeps its own saved progress (InteractableAutoPackOpener, AutoPackOpenerSaveData)

steps.do: Price every card you open before it goes on a shelf.
steps.because: card prices are applied through dedicated price objects (InteractableCardPriceTag)

commonMistakes: Opening every pack yourself and never shelving sealed stock.
Shelving cards that have not been priced.
Treating all packaging boxes as if they were the same kind of container.
sources: A local copy of the game, read only. Grounding for each step is on the technical reference pages; no number is estimated.
